headline: HIG Q2 Deep Dive: Hartford Balances Core Insurance Strength With Strategic Portfolio Moves
summary: Insurance and financial services company The Hartford (NYSE:HIG) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4% year on year to $7.26 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.42 per share was 8.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
